order_refunds_cash_fields.value:
("order_refunds"."tender_type" = 'CASH' OR "order_refunds"."cash_drawer_session_id" IS NULL)
        AND ("order_refunds"."tender_type" <> 'CASH' OR "order_refunds"."external_reference" IS NULL)

order_refunds_no_pan.name: order_refunds_no_pan
order_refunds_no_pan.value:
("order_refunds"."external_reference" IS NULL OR "order_refunds"."external_reference" !~ '[0-9]{13,}') AND ("order_refunds"."reason" IS NULL OR "order_refunds"."reason" !~ '[0-9]{13,}')
        AND ("order_refunds"."other_description" IS NULL OR "order_refunds"."other_description" !~ '[0-9]{13,}') AND ("order_refunds"."void_reason" IS NULL OR "order_refunds"."void_reason" !~ '[0-9]{13,}')

order_refunds_void_fields.name: order_refunds_void_fields
order_refunds_void_fields.value:
("order_refunds"."status" = 'VOIDED') = ("order_refunds"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("order_refunds"."voided_at" IS NULL) = ("order_refunds"."voided_by_user_id" IS NULL)
        AND ("order_refunds"."voided_at" IS NULL) = ("order_refunds"."void_reason" IS NULL)
        AND ("order_refunds"."void_reason" IS NULL OR length(trim("order_refunds"."void_reason")) > 0)

settlement_tenders_cash_fields.name: settlement_tenders_cash_fields
settlement_tenders_cash_fields.value:
("settlement_tenders"."tender_type" = 'CASH') = ("settlement_tenders"."received_amount" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("settlement_tenders"."tender_type" = 'CASH' OR "settlement_tenders"."change_amount" = 0)
        AND ("settlement_tenders"."received_amount" IS NULL
          OR "settlement_tenders"."change_amount" = "settlement_tenders"."received_amount" - "settlement_tenders"."amount" - "settlement_tenders"."tip_amount")

settlement_tenders_failed_fields.name: settlement_tenders_failed_fields
settlement_tenders_failed_fields.value:
("settlement_tenders"."status" = 'FAILED') = ("settlement_tenders"."failure_reason" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("settlement_tenders"."status" <> 'FAILED' OR ("settlement_tenders"."tender_type" = 'EXTERNAL_CARD' AND "settlement_tenders"."tip_amount" = 0))
        AND ("settlement_tenders"."failure_reason" IS NULL OR length(trim("settlement_tenders"."failure_reason")) > 0)

settlement_tenders_card_fields.name: settlement_tenders_card_fields
settlement_tenders_card_fields.value:
("settlement_tenders"."tender_type" = 'EXTERNAL_CARD'
          OR ("settlement_tenders"."card_brand" IS NULL AND "settlement_tenders"."card_last_four" IS NULL))
        AND ("settlement_tenders"."card_last_four" IS NULL OR "settlement_tenders"."card_last_four" ~ '^[0-9]{4}$')

settlement_tenders_no_pan.name: settlement_tenders_no_pan
settlement_tenders_no_pan.value:
("settlement_tenders"."external_reference" IS NULL OR "settlement_tenders"."external_reference" !~ '[0-9]{13,}') AND ("settlement_tenders"."provider_name" IS NULL OR "settlement_tenders"."provider_name" !~ '[0-9]{13,}')
        AND ("settlement_tenders"."card_brand" IS NULL OR "settlement_tenders"."card_brand" !~ '[0-9]{13,}') AND ("settlement_tenders"."authorization_reference" IS NULL OR "settlement_tenders"."authorization_reference" !~ '[0-9]{13,}')
        AND ("settlement_tenders"."other_description" IS NULL OR "settlement_tenders"."other_description" !~ '[0-9]{13,}') AND ("settlement_tenders"."failure_reason" IS NULL OR "settlement_tenders"."failure_reason" !~ '[0-9]{13,}')
        AND ("settlement_tenders"."void_reason" IS NULL OR "settlement_tenders"."void_reason" !~ '[0-9]{13,}')

settlement_tenders_void_fields.name: settlement_tenders_void_fields
settlement_tenders_void_fields.value:
("settlement_tenders"."status" = 'VOIDED') = ("settlement_tenders"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("settlement_tenders"."voided_at" IS NULL) = ("settlement_tenders"."voided_by_user_id" IS NULL)
        AND ("settlement_tenders"."voided_at" IS NULL) = ("settlement_tenders"."void_reason" IS NULL)
        AND ("settlement_tenders"."void_reason" IS NULL OR length(trim("settlement_tenders"."void_reason")) > 0)

order_settlements_completed_fields.name: order_settlements_completed_fields
order_settlements_completed_fields.value:
("order_settlements"."status" = 'COMPLETED') = ("order_settlements"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("order_settlements"."completed_at" IS NULL) = ("order_settlements"."completed_by_user_id" IS NULL)
        AND ("order_settlements"."completed_at" IS NULL) = ("order_settlements"."completed_business_date" IS NULL)
        AND ("order_settlements"."status" <> 'COMPLETED' OR "order_settlements"."tendered_amount" = "order_settlements"."order_amount_snapshot")

order_settlements_cancelled_fields.name: order_settlements_cancelled_fields
order_settlements_cancelled_fields.value:
("order_settlements"."status" = 'CANCELLED') = ("order_settlements"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("order_settlements"."cancelled_at" IS NULL) = ("order_settlements"."cancelled_by_user_id" IS NULL)
        AND ("order_settlements"."cancelled_at" IS NULL) = ("order_settlements"."cancel_reason" IS NULL)
        AND ("order_settlements"."cancel_reason" IS NULL OR length(trim("order_settlements"."cancel_reason")) > 0)

time_entries_sources_valid.name: time_entries_sources_valid
time_entries_sources_valid.value:
"time_entries"."clock_in_source" IN ('SELF', 'MANAGER')
        AND ("time_entries"."clock_out_source" IS NULL OR "time_entries"."clock_out_source" IN ('SELF', 'MANAGER', 'ADJUSTMENT'))

time_entries_clock_out_fields.name: time_entries_clock_out_fields
time_entries_clock_out_fields.value:
("time_entries"."clock_out_at" IS NULL) = ("time_entries"."clock_out_source" IS NULL)
        AND ("time_entries"."clock_out_at" IS NULL) = ("time_entries"."clock_out_by_user_id" IS NULL)
        AND ("time_entries"."clock_out_recorded_at" IS NULL) = ("time_entries"."clock_out_source" IS NULL OR "time_entries"."clock_out_source" = 'ADJUSTMENT')
        AND ("time_entries"."status" <> 'OPEN' OR "time_entries"."clock_out_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("time_entries"."status" <> 'CLOSED' OR "time_entries"."clock_out_at" IS NOT NULL)

time_entries_void_fields.name: time_entries_void_fields
time_entries_void_fields.value:
("time_entries"."status" = 'VOIDED') = ("time_entries"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("time_entries"."voided_at" IS NULL) = ("time_entries"."voided_by_user_id" IS NULL)
        AND ("time_entries"."voided_at" IS NULL) = ("time_entries"."void_reason" IS NULL)
        AND ("time_entries"."void_reason" IS NULL OR (length(trim("time_entries"."void_reason")) > 0 AND "time_entries"."void_reason" !~ '[0-9]{13,}'))

tip_distributions_void_fields.name: tip_distributions_void_fields
tip_distributions_void_fields.value:
("tip_distributions"."status" = 'VOIDED') = ("tip_distributions"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("tip_distributions"."voided_at" IS NULL) = ("tip_distributions"."voided_by_user_id" IS NULL)
        AND ("tip_distributions"."voided_at" IS NULL) = ("tip_distributions"."void_reason" IS NULL)
        AND ("tip_distributions"."void_reason" IS NULL OR (length(trim("tip_distributions"."void_reason")) > 0 AND "tip_distributions"."void_reason" !~ '[0-9]{13,}'))
